# Backup API

5 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/backup`

List backups

List all backups (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of backups | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backups` | array of [Backup](schemas.md#backup) | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/backup`

Create backup

Trigger a new backup (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | One of: `full`, `metadata-only`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Backup started | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `202` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | no | - |
| `id` | string (uuid) | no | - |
| `status` | string | no | One of: `pending`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `failed`. |
| `type` | string | no | One of: `full`, `metadata-only`. |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/backup/{id}`

Get backup

Get details of a specific backup (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Backup details | `application/json`: [Backup](schemas.md#backup) |
| `404` | Backup not found | - |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/backup/{id}/download`

Download backup

Download a backup file (admin only)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Backup file | `application/octet-stream`: string (binary) |
| `404` | Backup not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/restore`

Restore backup

Restore from a backup file (admin only) - multipart form upload

**Request body** (required)

`multipart/form-data`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string (binary) | yes | Backup file to restore |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Restore started | - |
| `400` | Invalid backup file | - |
| `409` | A restore is already in progress | - |
